assets.alt: 成年人俯身温柔安抚受惊的孩子
assets.scene: An adult kneels beside a frightened small child, speaking softly with a compassionate relaxed face and gently resting one open hand on the child's shoulder. Focus on the tender, delicate manner of comforting: soft gestures, eye-level attention and the child's gradually relieved face. This illustrates doing something gently, not merely a family portrait.

assets.alt: 安静阅读的人突然因跳出的猫而惊讶大笑
assets.scene: A person peacefully reading on a garden bench has just been surprised by a playful cat popping up from behind the bench and suddenly bursts into laughter, eyes widened, book lifted slightly in an involuntary quick reaction. A few small painterly movement strokes convey the abrupt unexpected moment. Show harmless surprise, no injury or danger.
